scene.ko: 새로 친해진 동료에게 주말에 같이 등산 가자고 제안했다가, 상대가 망설이자 부담 없는 계획으로 바꿔 약속을 잡는다.

lines.en: Hey, Ben, are you free this Saturday? A few of us are going hiking at Achasan. Want to join?
lines.ko: 벤 씨, 이번 토요일에 시간 있어요? 몇 명이서 아차산에 등산 가는데, 같이 갈래요?
alt: Ben, are you doing anything on Saturday? Some of us are hiking Achasan. Would you like to come?

lines.en: Oh, thanks for asking! Honestly, though, I'm not much of a hiker. I'd probably slow everyone down.
lines.ko: 오, 물어봐 줘서 고마워요! 그런데 솔직히 저는 등산을 잘 못해서요. 아마 다들 저 때문에 느려질 거예요.

lines.en: Don't worry, it's a really easy trail. But no pressure at all if it's not your thing.
lines.ko: 걱정 마요, 정말 쉬운 코스예요. 그래도 별로 안 끌리면 전혀 부담 갖지 마요.
alt: It's an easy trail, so don't worry. But it's totally fine if hiking isn't your thing.

lines.en: It's not that I don't want to hang out. I just have a bad knee.
lines.ko: 같이 놀기 싫어서 그런 건 아니에요. 그냥 무릎이 좀 안 좋아서요.

lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. In that case, how about meeting us for lunch afterward? We're going to a noodle place at the bottom of the trail.
lines.ko: 아이고, 그랬군요. 그럼 끝나고 점심만 같이 먹는 건 어때요? 산 아래 국숫집에 갈 거예요.
alt: Oh, sorry to hear that. Then why don't you just join us for lunch afterward? We're eating at a noodle place near the bottom.

lines.en: That sounds perfect, actually. What time would that be?
lines.ko: 사실 그게 딱 좋겠네요. 몇 시쯤이에요?

lines.en: Probably around one. I'll text you when we're on our way down.
alt: Around one, I think. I'll send you a message when we start heading down.

lines.en: Just your appetite! The kalguksu there is amazing.
lines.ko: 배만 비워 오세요! 거기 칼국수가 진짜 맛있거든요.
alt: Just come hungry! Their kalguksu is so good.
Nothing, just bring your appetite. The kalguksu is great.

lines.en: Ha, that I can do. Thanks for the invite!
lines.ko: 하하, 그건 자신 있어요. 불러 줘서 고마워요!

expressions.note: 약속을 제안하기 전에 먼저 묻는 말
Do you want to join us? 를 줄인 말

expressions.en: No pressure at all if it's not your thing.
expressions.ko: 안 끌리면 전혀 부담 갖지 마요.
expressions.note: not my thing = 내 취향이 아니다
상대 사정에 맞춰 다른 안을 낼 때
Should I bring anything? 에 재치 있게 답할 때
